extracted.intended_audience: trainers and participants of mathematical competitions (high school and undergraduate), high-school teachers running math clubs, and individual problem-solvers
extracted.subtask_description: A training/reference book that collects competition problems and extensive discussions of problem-solving strategies for high-school and early-undergraduate level contests (IMO, Tournament of the Towns, noncalculus Putnam). Used by trainers, contestants, and teachers to present examples, problems, and solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Problem selection from major competitions
rubrics_metrics.description: A unique collection of competition problems from over twenty major national and international mathematical competitions for high school students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes problems drawn from contests up to the highest level: IMO, Tournament of the Towns, and the noncalculus parts of the Putnam Competition. Intended to provide a wide and representative selection of contest problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Depth of discussion of problem-solving strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: The discussion of problem solving strategies is extensive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book emphasizes strategy as well as problems; chapters and commentary aim to teach approaches, not just present solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Range of difficulty / target levels
rubrics_metrics.description: Written for trainers and participants of contests of all levels up to the highest level: IMO, Tournament of the Towns, and the noncalculus parts of the Putnam Competition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suitable for a spectrum from simple to very challenging problems; intended to serve both beginners and top-level competitors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Usefulness for instructors and clubs
rubrics_metrics.description: Appeals to high school teachers conducting a mathematics club who need a range of simple to complex problems and to instructors wishing to pose a 'problem of the week', 'problem of the month', and 'research problem of the year'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides material usable in ongoing classroom/club settings to foster a creative atmosphere via continuous discussion of problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on non-routine and challenging problems
rubrics_metrics.description: A resource to enrich teaching with interesting non-routine problems and for individuals interested in solving difficult and challenging problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritizes problems that develop creative problem-solving skills rather than routine exercise practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter structure: examples then problems then solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Each chapter starts with typical examples illustrating the central concepts and is followed by a number of carefully selected problems and their solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommend working through the illustrative examples as part of learning; problems are curated to reinforce central concepts introduced at chapter start.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solution completeness and variety
rubrics_metrics.description: Most of the solutions are complete, but some merely point to the road leading to the final solution. Very few problems have no solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mix of full solutions, hints/roadmaps, and occasional unsolved problems—useful both for self-study and guided instruction; be prepared for some solutions to be sketches rather than full derivations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended practice to increase effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Readers interested in increasing the effectiveness of the book can do so by working on the examples in addition to the problems thereby increasing the number of problems to over 1300.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actively solving both chapter examples and listed problems substantially increases practice volume; treat examples as solvable exercises to maximize benefit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensiveness as a training resource
rubrics_metrics.description: This volume is the most complete training book on the market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positioned as a comprehensive single-source training reference for contest preparation and instructor use; aims to cover a broad spectrum of topics and difficulty levels for contest training.
